items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: Buddy and I were friends and that was I guess my time sense is Buddy Rich’s time sense.

ctx.x: Right. I had a set of drums. I used to play them when I was twelve years old to Buddy Rich doing “Well Git It” in Tommy Dorsey’s band. Things like that. And it was a — Exeter’s a rich boy’s school, come on. And boys leave stuff behind. And I’m a faculty brat, right for Phillips Exeter. I mean I’m growing up and running around and still not running my own show basically. And a boy left in the basement of Dunbar it was a full set of drums but it was not what we would think of playing in today’s rock band, it was…
“St. Louis Blues” march. Yes, I used to love that.
